title: Pancakes with honeyed figs and ham

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is a whole food or a staple: flour, eggs, milk, butter, honey, figs, ham and yoghurt.

supermarket.reason: Figs are sold in mainstream supermarkets in late summer at an everyday price, and the rest are basics.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a bowl, a whisk and a frying pan, and drop pancakes are within a beginner's reach.

works.reason: 200g flour with 2 eggs and 250ml milk makes a thick drop-pancake batter for about a dozen, and 6 figs plus 8 slices of ham sensibly feed four.

honest_times.reason: 30 active minutes covers mixing and frying the pancakes in batches plus the figs, which is believable at a standard pace.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed item, including the thyme and butter, is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: Late August is fig season, and the honeyed figs are the centre of the plate rather than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and in plain British English.

hearty_healthy.reason: Wholemeal pancakes with ham, yoghurt and fruit make a filling, balanced breakfast.
